## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 411 captures during April 2026. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists running as scheduled apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. No additional operational issues were recorded in the information provided.

## Image quality

There were 26 ungradable captures. This represented an ungradable rate of 6.3 per cent for the month. The rate indicates the proportion of captures that could not be assessed for grading. Image quality should continue to be monitored through routine site review, with attention given to any recurring factors that may affect the ability to obtain gradable images.

## Grading

Grading identified 127 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. This provides an overview of grading timeliness alongside the number of referable results identified. Overall, the activity, image quality and grading figures should be considered together when reviewing service performance at Harbour Eye Clinic during April 2026.
